current_objective: Deliver the second atomic ORBYVEN 1.0 data-portability milestone: bounded CSV/TSV source parsing plus an authenticated tenant-scoped read-only import preflight endpoint, with no database or Storage writes.
last_completed: Audited current main for import, Documents/Storage, export/offboarding and compliance before implementation.
Confirmed app/api/workspace/data-export/route.ts plus lib/compliance/exit-export.ts are the canonical tenant-scoped export/offboarding path and must be reused rather than duplicated.
Confirmed organization offboarding migration exists and canonical export intentionally excludes Storage file bytes for separate verified transfer.

Confirmed lib/modules/documents.ts is the existing document/storage abstraction: orbyven-documents bucket, organization-prefixed paths, upsert=false, signature validation and organization-scoped contextual linking.
Implemented and integrated PR #355 as main commit 0f88852 after Architecture Guard, CI and Quality Gate were green.
Re-audited app/api/workspace on main and confirmed there was no existing import/preflight API or CSV parser to reuse.
Confirmed authenticateBillingActor already provides the canonical bearer-token to organization-membership boundary needed for an authenticated read-only import preflight endpoint.
Implemented dependency-free bounded CSV/semicolon-CSV/TSV parsing with BOM, CRLF, quoted delimiters, multiline values, escaped quotes and strict source/cell/row/column limits.
Parser pads missing trailing cells, preserves blank rows for explicit skip reporting, and fails closed when a row is wider than its header so extra values are never silently discarded.
Implemented /api/workspace/data-import/preflight using canonical authenticateBillingActor tenant resolution, private no-store responses and zero database/Storage writes.
The endpoint forbids client-supplied existingRecords and explicitly blocks execution confirmation until a later canonical existing-data duplicate adapter is connected.
Added targeted parser/API boundary tests and included them in the existing test:data suite without new dependencies.
